reviewer: craft — independent visible-output review; emphasis on typography, materials and construction
method: Reviewed only the anonymous packet, its review protocol, the six raw briefs and supplied images. All 17 variants were actually viewed at native resolution, width 720 and long-edge 320. PNG native dimensions were read directly from the supplied image headers. Invitation CTA readings below were made directly from the width-720 images before cross-checking their text against the copy list. Punctuation and spaces are visual readings, not Unicode-byte verification. Scores concern delivered visual conditions and make no authorship claim. No new rubric was added during this review.

evidence.content_form: Center beach scene shows two volunteers, a grabber, litter and an open bag; the orange bag and orange CTA connect the activity to joining it.

evidence.space: Full-width headline and footer frame the central people; the image dissolves into the pale copy area without touching the date block.
evidence.image_material: At native resolution gloves, cloth folds, silver grabber and wrinkled orange bag share a consistent illustrated treatment; the grabber ends meet the crumpled transparent litter.
evidence.emotion_control: Friendly expressions and daylight make participation approachable; the orange is concentrated in the bag and CTA rather than scattered across the poster.
evidence.ai_slop: The cleanup-specific grabber/litter/bag interaction and intact text prevent a merely decorative scene; the uniformly polished volunteer poses still read as a familiar recruitment formula.

residuals: The title and recruitment subtitle occupy about the upper quarter, leaving the detailed participation block relatively tight below the hero.
The staged smiling volunteer pair is less precise as an activity explanation than a close view of the actual grabber-to-bag action.

conditions.readability_720: The sole required title is readable; see order note where applicable.
conditions.prohibited_marks: Only 밤에 피는 정원 appears; no extra text, logo or watermark observed.

evidence.content_form: The photograph's pale flowers line a dark garden path under nighttime light; the path invites the viewer into the subject named at its base.
evidence.hierarchy: At 320 the large left flower and pale bottom title remain distinguishable; at 720 the path leads downward naturally into the title, though the image leads before the words.
evidence.typography: The lightly calligraphic/serif Korean title has generous spacing and sits on the dark path with sufficient contrast; it is quieter than the image but fully readable.
evidence.space: Foreground leaves frame both edges, flowers step back into the depth and the narrow path opens a central channel; title placement uses that channel rather than covering blooms.
evidence.image_material: Native petal folds, leaves, stems and soil have photo-like detail with foreground softness and deeper foliage recession; the dark middle loses some fine separation.
evidence.emotion_control: The cool shadows and restrained pale flower highlights create a convincing intimate night mood without glow particles or decorative props.
evidence.ai_slop: Specific garden depth, a real-looking path and controlled title placement are coherent; some central botanical detail remains indistinct in darkness rather than being strongly resolved.

residuals: The very dark central foliage sacrifices detail separation, particularly at thumbnail size.
The title is near the bottom and secondary to the scene, which suits atmosphere but makes it a slower first read.

mandatory.transcription_notes: The sole title reads as one middle-lower line. No additional wording observed.

conditions.target_ratio: 2:3 (packet target; no ratio stated in raw garden brief)
conditions.subject: Photo-like small flowering plant and enlarged floral shadow on a textured blue wall.
conditions.readability_720: The sole required title is readable; see order note where applicable.
conditions.prohibited_marks: Only 밤에 피는 정원 appears; no extra text, logo or watermark observed.

evidence.content_form: The small flowering plant casts a much larger floral shadow up the blue wall; the transformation of real blossoms into a nocturnal silhouette connects all major elements.
evidence.hierarchy: The large flower shadow leads at 320, followed by the pale middle-lower title and small illuminated plant; the words remain clear at 720.
evidence.typography: The simple cream title line crosses the shadow field without losing readability; its weight sits between the delicate real blossoms and broad silhouette.
evidence.space: The plant anchors the lower left, the expanded shadow fills the upper wall and the title bridges the scale change; the right wall has useful breathing room.
evidence.image_material: Native wall grain, leaf edges, petal folds and soft-edged cast shadow are differentiated; the projected shadow is coherent as an expressive image, though its exact botanical correspondence is not fully traceable.
evidence.emotion_control: The warm low-left light against cool wall and oversized shadow creates a precise quiet-night atmosphere; no unrelated ornament is present.
evidence.ai_slop: The plant/shadow scale idea and restrained text are specific with clean edges; the shadow correspondence remains a visible uncertainty rather than evidence of physical testing.

residuals: The shadow's stems and leaves are less independently traceable to the small plant than its three prominent flowers.
The title is compositionally clear but uses a straightforward overlay rather than a more closely integrated lettering treatment.

evidence: X211 uses an ascending branch and stepped words; X515 makes the title a structure for climbing vines; X250 uses a borderless pattern and single title corridor.
X800 makes a dark photographic path lead toward the title; X455 uses small plant/large cast-shadow scale with a title bridge.
Closest pair X211/X250 shares cream pale flowers, dark teal ground and bold Korean text, but branch/empty-field composition differs from full-surface repeat.
residuals: Three directions retain pale botanical imagery over a dark blue/teal field. That shared vocabulary limits the breadth despite different title roles and spatial concepts.
X250 is the least subject-specific construction; stronger directions do not compensate for it.

evidence: X752 shows two illustrated volunteers cooperating in a central scene; X235 uses a photograph-like close view of grabber, bottle and woven sack.
Both still use very large navy type at the top, stacked operational copy, a beach hero and orange application band near the bottom.
residuals: Image treatment and activity scale differ meaningfully, but the typography's role and CTA structure remain close.
X235's smaller rules and uneven blue emphasis remain unresolved within the current set; comparison variants are not counted as additional deliverables.

evidence: X209 uses a hand pressing one open cup with detached lid; X799 pairs expanded/collapsed lidded states, changing the feature demonstration.
Both use a pale neutral studio surface, dark-green oversized FOLN/Fold Cup header and large centered release/date information at the bottom.
residuals: The functional story changes more than the visual system; typography, background, palette and footer structure are closely related.
X436 is a same-slot comparison and is excluded from this current-set score.

evidence: X448 uses a frontal worn-boot close-up and floating upper title; X344 places the title behind a skater and a curved rink track with lower-left information.
Both require and deliver chrome and strong neon, but they also share the same upper-title/large-skates/reflective-floor/event-footer structure beyond those mandatory materials.
residuals: The perspective and title staging differ; the main information and image roles still repeat.
X344's title occlusion and crowded upper-right boundary remain the weak member's finishing issue.

evidence: X782 uses a photographed torn textile and magnifier, while X477 depicts hands working together on a wooden hinge in illustration.
Different repair acts and material systems are meaningful, but both have a huge navy header, date/detail text beside a central object, lower conditions and orange CTA block.
residuals: Subject and medium diversify the pair more than typography or overall information structure.
The square image narrows the activity toward sewing; the tall image has a notably small entry-time line.

evidence: Single requested artwork; multi-image diversity scoring does not apply.

pair1.reason: X176 gives a tighter, more explicit tool-to-litter-to-bag action and a stable pale copy block. X752 is readable and welcoming, but its large smiling volunteer scene and very heavy upper title provide less precise activity explanation. Both deadlines and complete URLs are easy to find.
pair1.uncertainty: Neither has a confirmed text omission or major construction defect. X752's social warmth could be appropriate for a different recruitment emphasis; the preference is based on visible action clarity and spatial restraint.

pair2.reason: X168 keeps the operational copy on one pale field with a predictable hierarchy and larger, more evenly readable conditions at 720. X235's photo-like sack is materially strong, but its enlarged equipment sentence, small lower rules and close image/text packing weaken the reading order.
pair2.uncertainty: X235 offers the more tangible woven sack and debris photograph. Both are readable and both application bands are clear, so this is a hierarchy/spacing preference rather than a claim that photography is inferior.

pair3.reason: X799 directly shows expanded and collapsed lidded states and gives launch/order information a stronger quick read. X436 has better material differentiation and a strong diagonal photograph layout, but its one compact-state object can initially read as a bowl and its small footer groups are separated across the width.
pair3.uncertainty: X436's quiet serif title and textile/wood scene have better spatial and material finish. X799's oversized brand is conventional; the preference rests on the visible folding explanation and information access, not an assumed preferred style.

review_limits: mandatory.pass records no confirmed visible requirement failure; it is not Unicode-byte proof. Title occlusion and punctuation uncertainties remain explicitly recorded.
